name: SCSU Makerspace at Buley Library
summary: Southern Connecticut State University's makerspace, run by the Hilton C. Buley Library on its ground floor: 3D printing, sewing and crafts, a Cricut, button making, a green screen room and lendable kits.

address.notes: Ground floor of Hilton C. Buley Library, Southern Connecticut State University.

sources.note: Library guide: 'provided by the Hilton C. Buley University Library'; 'Visit us on the ground floor of Buley Library!'; service areas Sewing & Crafting, Cricut, Button Making, Green Screen Room/AV Equipment, 3D Printing (two Makerbot Sketch printers); kits to check out. Instagram @scsu_makerspace.
Buley Library: 501 Crescent Street, New Haven, CT 06515; main line 203-392-5750 (the library's, not the makerspace's own).
Coordinates: the Census geocoder's match for the library's street address.

gaps: whether people outside SCSU may use it is not stated; 3D prints are collected with a University ID
